parts.stem: The directors wish to pay a large final dividend. Evaluate whether the company's liquidity could support it.

points.description: The current ratio is 1.17 : 1, so current assets cover current liabilities
Cash and equivalents are 20,140 while income tax payable is 11,860 and trade payables 19,770, so cash is limited and a large dividend could cause an overdraft
Judgement: a modest dividend could be paid, but a large one would weaken liquidity and the loan notes interest still has to be paid

answerSpec.markingNotes: Example answer: The current ratio of 1.17 : 1 looks adequate, but cash of 20,140 is small compared with the tax and payables due. A large dividend could cause an overdraft, so only a modest dividend is advisable.
